Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 3

“The Blessed Lord said: In this world there is a twofold path, as I said before, sinless one — the yoga of knowledge for the contemplative, and the yoga of action for the active.”

Krishna does not deny the two paths; he distributes them by temperament. Different people are suited to different approaches, which is exactly why his teaching sounded double to Arjuna.
